name: Pool of Tears
summary: In Stonard, Fel'zerul sends you to search the Pool of Tears for Atal'ai artifacts. The Warchief's people came to investigate strange events at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar and found it sunk.

sections.title: The Sunken Temple
sections.body: The Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters known for forbidden magic. Fel'zerul's party reached the Temple of Atal'Hakkar and found it sunk. Green dragons now watch over the temple and call themselves protectors of Azeroth.

sections.title: Pieces of a Puzzle
sections.body: Fel'zerul wants to learn what happened, so he asks you to gather Atal'ai artifacts around the Pool of Tears. The pieces may help the puzzle come together. No one knows what dark rites the trolls practiced in the temple, only that they used great magical forces. Fel'zerul hopes their spells may aid the Horde. He wants to learn what the Atal'ai sought and what went so horribly wrong.

faq.answer: Fel'zerul is in Stonard, among those the Warchief sent to investigate strange events at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in the Atal'ai trolls?
faq.answer: Fel'zerul says great magical forces were used at the temple. He hopes the Atal'ai's spells may prove useful to the Horde.

faq.q: Where are the Atal'ai artifacts located?
faq.answer: The Atal'ai artifacts lie on the bed of the Pool of Tears, near the temple.

faq.q: Who guards the sunken temple now?
faq.answer: Green dragons watch over the sunken temple and call themselves protectors of Azeroth.

faq.q: What comes next after the artifacts are delivered?
aliases: next quest after pool of tears
